messages:
karen: quick sync 1: thinking about converging shadow-lease proxy + key attestation. want to note tradeoffs before I write the addendum.

leo: tl;dr?

karen: shadow-lease = proxy mints short leases so partners never hold long key. attestation = snapshot of effective RBAC at key issuance for drift detection. combineable: annotate leases with key attestation id so audit and drift tooling link.

anya: sounds good. main tradeoffs: extra hop/latency for partner calls, ops for proxy, and storage for attestations. pros: traceability + faster key rotation + reduced secret exposure.

leo: implementation notes: lease token should include attestation_id and original_key_id. sample claims: {"iss":"lease-proxy","sub":"partner:x","attest":"a_123","exp":1790123550}. proxy logs mint -> attest mapping.

karen: migration plan idea: 1) add attestation on new key issuance; 2) build lightweight proxy beta + SDK wrapper; 3) pilot with 1 partner; 4) require for new external keys after 60d.

anya: edge-cases: offline batch jobs (offer sidecar/refresh token), high-throughput partners (allow whitelisted long leases), and emergency bypass (2-approver audit).

leo: RBAC checks: always validate both token claims and current resource ACLs on server-side. do not rely solely on lease claims for sensitive endpoints.

security-bot: ACTION: draft addendum linking attestation schema + lease token schema; add console view to show lease->attestation trace; schedule pilot.

karen: i'll draft and ping @leo @anya for review. thanks :thumbsup:
file_note: short Slack thread: combining shadow-lease proxy and key attestation; migration plan and edge-cases. concise messages and action items.
